title: ROT13 Cipher
description: Write a Zig program that applies the ROT13 cipher (shift by 13) to a string.
verificationTest: output.includes('Original: Hello, Zig!') && output.includes('ROT13: Uryyb, Mvt!')

Use `and` for logical AND in Zig conditions
